storeInfo.name: Monty's Munchies at The Dinosaur Place
storeInfo.tagline: Prehistoric appetite satisfaction for explorers of all ages | Satisfaciendo apetitos prehistóricos para exploradores de todas las edades

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado cerca de la entrada principal del parque de diversiones.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located near the main entrance of the adventure park.
policies.restroomCodeEs: Abierto para todos los visitantes del parque.
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Amplio estacionamiento gratuito disponible en el parque The Dinosaur Place.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Ample free parking available at The Dinosaur Place lot.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a nuestro personal de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify our staff immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio rápido en el mostrador para disfrutar en el parque o llevar.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Quick counter service available to enjoy on-site or take to go.

products.nameEnEs: Nuggets dorados y crujientes con forma de dinosaurio, servidos con salsa BBQ o miel con mostaza.
products.descriptionEn: Golden, crispy dinosaur-shaped chicken nuggets served with your choice of BBQ or honey mustard dipping sauce.

products.nameEs: Fósiles de Papas Fritas con Queso
products.descriptionEs: Papas fritas en corte onda cubiertas con salsa de queso cheddar fundido y trocitos de tocino crujiente.
products.descriptionEn: Winkle-cut french fries smothered in warm melted cheddar cheese sauce and crispy bacon bits.

products.descriptionEs: Aros de cebolla rebozados y fritos hasta alcanzar un dorado perfecto, servidos con aderezo ranch de la casa.
products.descriptionEn: Thick-cut onion rings battered and fried to golden perfection, served with house-made ranch dressing.
Juicy grilled beef patty topped with cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, and special Monty sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
Crispy breaded chicken breast topped with tangy pickles, lettuce, and chipotle mayo on an artisan roll.
All-beef footlong frank grilled to perfection in a soft bakery bun, topped with onions, relish, and classic yellow mustard.
Grilled chicken strips, fresh spring mix, Monterey Jack cheese, and ranch dressing wrapped tightly in a soft flour tortilla.
Crispy breaded chicken tenders tossed in our mildly spicy buffalo sauce, served with french fries and blue cheese dressing.
Large toasted tortilla filled with a blend of melted cheeses, served with sour cream and mild house salsa.
Freshly squeezed classic lemonade with a hint of natural strawberry flavor. Sweet and refreshing.
Rich and creamy real chocolate milkshake topped with whipped cream, sprinkles, and a crispy wafer straw.

products.nameEs: Galleta Gigante con Chispas de Chocolate
products.descriptionEn: Freshly baked warm butter cookie loaded with semi-sweet chocolate chunks.

faqs.qEs: ¿Tienen opciones para personas con alergias alimentarias?
faqs.qEn: Do you offer options for guests with food allergies?
faqs.aEs: Sí, informen a nuestro personal en el mostrador sobre cualquier alergia para recomendarles las opciones adecuadas.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please inform our staff at the counter about any allergies so we can recommend suitable options.

faqs.qEs: ¿Necesito entrada al parque para comer en Monty's Munchies?
faqs.qEn: Do I need park admission to dine at Monty's Munchies?
faqs.aEs: Nuestro restaurante está ubicado dentro de The Dinosaur Place, por lo que se requiere acceso al parque para visitarnos.
faqs.aEn: Our restaurant is located inside The Dinosaur Place, so park admission is required to visit us.

faqs.aEs: Sí, puedes ordenar directamente en el mostrador para llevar y disfrutar en las áreas de picnic del parque.
faqs.aEn: Yes, you can order directly at the counter to-go and enjoy in the park's picnic areas.
